findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_california_surf, get_health, get_lightning, get_my_notification_settings, get_my_settings, get_parking_guides, get_release_updates · Private data: find_boat_ramps, find_fuel_docks, find_marinas, find_waterfront_dining, get_boat, get_california_river, get_dataset, get_fishing_heatmap, get_fishing_insights, get_fishing_records, get_jellyfish_observations, get_poi, get_poi_details, get_rainfall_history, get_shark_research, get_spot, list_california_facilities, list_california_places, list_california_spots · Public sink: update_my_notification_settings · Destructive: delete_my_place, delete_my_trip, get_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_california_surf, get_health, get_lightning, get_my_notification_settings, get_my_settings, get_parking_guides, get_release_updates · Private data: find_boat_ramps, find_fuel_docks, find_marinas, find_waterfront_dining, get_boat, get_california_river, get_dataset, get_fishing_heatmap, get_fishing_insights, get_fishing_records, get_jellyfish_observations, get_poi, get_poi_details, get_rainfall_history, get_shark_research, get_spot, list_california_facilities, list_california_places, list_california_spots · Public sink: update_my_notification_settings · Destructive: delete_my_place, delete_my_trip, get_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
